name: NIST Privacy Framework
description: Focused NIST Privacy Framework 1.0 (CSWP 10) pack. Operationalizes privacy-risk Function evidence gates (IDENTIFY-P / GOVERN-P / CONTROL-P / COMMUNICATE-P / PROTECT-P) as Enigma controls under privacy.nist_pf. Framework — not legal authority, not a certification, not GDPR/HIPAA determination, not a DSAR/DPIA workflow or privacy score. Distinct from ISO/IEC 27701 PIMS.
semantic_notes: NIST Privacy Framework 1.0 is FRAMEWORK — treatsAsLegalAuthority === false
Uses governance_context.privacy.nist_pf only — does not read ISO/IEC 27701 PIMS top-level fields
Satisfying NIST PF does not satisfy ISO 27701 (and vice versa)
Does not implement GDPR lawful-basis determination, DSAR workflow, DPIA application, or privacy scoring
deliberately_not_implemented: PII scanner / privacy GRC platform / PrivacyScore
